attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10, exercised a full failover (node1 lost -> node2 promoted -> node3 repointed -> node1 rejoined as standby of node2) with zero data loss, and completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
